scope: P10 music publication inside HiChat LiveKit rooms without disabling the room E2EE contract.
implemented: The music publisher obtains the active passphrase and monotonic key index through a narrow read-only voice-room key source.
Opus frames use LiveKit AES-GCM frame encryption and the publication is explicitly marked Encryption_GCM; production publication refuses to start without a room key source.
Key derivation uses the LiveKit/JS-compatible PBKDF2 salt, SHA-256 iteration count and AES-128 key length.
The provider observes key-index rotation for subsequent frames and refuses stale key indices.
Room cleanup removes both the passphrase and its rotation index; participant-removal rotation advances both together.
The opt-in loopback YouTube smoke listener now rejects plaintext publications and decrypts Opus frames before validating decoded non-silent audio.
